application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 Pittosporum of the submitted MWA Arboricultural Report (21Ashmount Road)
Works: Remove (fell) to near ground level and treat stump to inhibit regrowth.

T2 Sycamore of the submitted MWA Arboricultural Report (21Ashmount Road)
Works: Remove (fell) to near ground level. Owner to physically remove any regrowth (no chemical treatment due to translocation risk).

TG1 Mixed species group including Bamboo, Olive & Fig of the submitted MWA Arboricultural Report (21Ashmount Road)
Works: Remove (fell) to near ground level all shrubs within 5m of the property. Owner to physically remove any regrowth (no chemical treatment due to translocation risk). Maintain remaining broadly at no more than current dimensions by periodic pruning.

Reason: Clay shrinkage subsidence damage at the subject property 21 Ashmount Road, N19 3BJ.
